site.name: ASDA Leyton Mills Superstore
site.address: 1 Leyton Mills, Marshall Road, Leyton, London E10 5NH
site.coord_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim shop node (51.5563628, -0.0090093); address confirmed on the ASDA store locator (Marshall Road, Leyton E10 5NH). Open-air/surface car park confirmed by AccessAble.

question: How busy is this supermarket car park, from orbit?

models.yolo11m-obb: Ultralytics YOLO11m-OBB (DOTAv1), tiled 256px/25% overlap, imgsz 1024, conf>=0.10, rotated NMS probIoU 0.4; vehicles only (other DOTA classes dropped). Conf lowered from 0.25 used on Oxford Circus because vehicles here are ~24 px and grey-on-grey on asphalt; conf 0.25 recalled only 11 in-lot vehicles.
models.owlv2: google/owlv2-base-patch16-ensemble, tiled 640px/20% overlap, score>=0.20 for cars/trucks (lowered from the Oxford Circus extra-car cut of 0.30 for the same reason), NMS 0.4 then overlap-filter vs YOLO (IoU 0.1). Size filter 8–90 px, area 40–3500 px². Only vehicles inside the customer car-park polygon are kept.

imagery.source: Esri World_Imagery XYZ tiles, zoom 19 (~0.19 m/px)
imagery.attribution: Source: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
imagery.date: unknown (Esri mosaic; capture date not published on the XYZ tiles)
imagery.note: Crop is a 278 m square centred a little south-west of the store so the surface customer car park and the store are both in frame. The A12, the railway, surrounding houses and the store's northern loading dock were kept out of the count polygon.

bays.method: Four marked bay-grid polygons were traced on the z19 mosaic: the west tree-island lot (including the close-in bays along the store's west facade), the south marked lot, the east lot between the store and the adjacent retail shed, and the short-stay bays south of the store. Arterial/spine roads, the central roundabout and the neighbouring shed roof were excluded. Total marked area 27496 m² ÷ 30 m² per bay = 917 bays (west 11352 m² → 378; south 7232 m² → 241; east 6536 m² → 218; front 2375 m² → 79). 30 m² per bay (including aisles and tree islands) is used rather than the 25 m² efficient-lot rule of thumb because this retail-park layout has large tree islands and wide aisles; 25 m² would imply 1100 bays, above the published figure of roughly 890 spaces for the whole Leyton Mills Retail Park (shared by ASDA, TK Maxx and other units; carparkcheck.co.uk, not independently verified). 917 bays is consistent with that published figure, given that this frame covers the main shared surface lots and not every peripheral service space.
bays.published_source: carparkcheck.co.uk, Leyton Mills Retail Park (ASDA, TK Maxx and others sharing one car park); not independently verified.

occupancy.definition: vehicles inside the customer car-park polygon / estimated bays. A small number of vehicles sit on internal aisles or the spine road rather than in a marked stall.

false_positives: A handful of low-score (0.20–0.22) boxes in the west and south lots fall on empty-bay shadows, tree-island gaps or a possible bin near the north-west perimeter rather than a clear vehicle (visual estimate: about 4–8).
One oversized box over a tight cluster of cars in the north-east of the east lot was rejected by the size filter; those cars are missed rather than merged into one count.
misses: The east lot is the fullest area and the model still misses a number of low-contrast or tightly packed cars (visual review: on the order of 10–20 vehicles without a box).
Some dark cars under the west-lot tree canopies are also missed.
YOLO11m-OBB at the Oxford Circus conf of 0.25 only found 11 in-lot vehicles; even at 0.10 it under-detects on this grey asphalt. OWLv2 carries most of the count.
other_notes: Fill % is therefore a slight lower bound on how many vehicles are actually in the car park, partly offset by the few false positives above.
The lot is shared with neighbouring retail units in Leyton Mills Retail Park, so the figure is park-level occupancy, not ASDA-only customers.

Three white vans parked on the verge north-west of the access road were left outside the polygon (not in the marked customer bays). The store's northern loading-dock lorries were also excluded. A false box on the adjacent retail shed roof was filtered out.
